# Castward

> Fishing trip guides, water guides, gear comparisons, and planning tools.

Castward publishes destination and preparation information. Confirm current rules with the cited fisheries authority.

## Useful pages

- [Castward | Find your water. Go prepared.](https://castward.app/): Explore 796 fishing profiles worldwide, including 507 U.S., Canadian and Mexican trips with state and province navigation and personalized preparation.
- [About Castward](https://castward.app/about/): About Castward for the Castward fishing atlas, local plans and contact service.
- [Fishing trip guides, seasons and packing lists](https://castward.app/guides/): Plan a fishing trip with source-checked destination guides, charter comparisons, seasonal advice and practical packing lists from Castward.
- [Fishing License & Licence Prices by State and Country](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/): Find fishing license prices, age rules and official purchase links by state and country. Compare 15 resident options and plan your visitor permit.
- [Florida visitor fishing license planner](https://castward.app/guides/florida-visitor-fishing-license-planner/): Florida visitors aged 16 or older usually need a fishing license, even for catch and release. A properly licensed saltwater charter or pier can cover that outing. Use this planner to separate those trips from beach, private-boat, and freshwater fishing before you choose your license.
- [Ice Fishing: Find the Fish Beneath Your Feet](https://castward.app/environments/ice-fishing/): Plan a first ice-fishing trip: compare a guide with a rental house, check the route, pack dry layers, and learn a simple panfish setup.
- [Minnesota fish house rental: compare two trips](https://castward.app/guides/minnesota-fish-house-rental-checklist/): Compare Minnesota guided ice trips and fish house rentals: instruction, tackle, transport, sleeper supplies, and a printable two-quote worksheet.
- [Florida Keys fishing guide & personalized packing list](https://castward.app/destinations/florida-keys/): From a quiet skiff to a day offshore. Pick the experience, then pack for it.
- [Bozeman & Big Sky fishing guide & personalized packing list](https://castward.app/destinations/bozeman/): A river day, without the guesswork. Get clear on wading, floating and what to bring.
- [Yakutat fishing: Situk River, halibut and trip planning](https://castward.app/destinations/yakutat/): Plan a Yakutat fishing trip around Situk River salmon, steelhead or coastal halibut. Compare access, seasonal patterns and the gear questions to ask.
- [Fishing Waters: Rivers, Lakes, Flats, Surf and Ice](https://castward.app/environments/): How rivers, lakes, flats, surf, reefs, ice and open ocean fish, what to bring for each, and real trips to plan.
- [Fishing Lingo by Region: Slams, Nicknames and Local Terms](https://castward.app/fishing-lingo/): A field guide to 157 fishing terms from 27 regions. Find local fish names, slams, and the words you hear on the water.
- [Weather](https://castward.app/tools/weather/): Weather forecasts for your next fishing trip.
- [Tides](https://castward.app/tools/tides/): Tides forecasts for your next fishing trip.
- [Interactive fishing atlas](https://castward.app/atlas/): Explore fishing trips on an interactive world map. Filter by water, environment, species and month, then find your next trip.
- [Fraser River catch and release sturgeon: rules & licences](https://castward.app/trip-types/fraser-white-sturgeon/): Fraser River sturgeon are catch and release only. Check freshwater and tidal licences, the sturgeon conservation licence, barbless hooks and closure areas.
- [Buoy 10 salmon fishing: season and charter checklist](https://castward.app/trip-types/buoy-10-salmon/): Check Buoy 10 salmon fishing rules for late 2026, barbless hooks, tide risks and the questions to ask a guide before you book.
- [Sight fishing: tailing redfish, tides and trip planning](https://castward.app/trip-types/sight-fishing/): Learn what tailing redfish mean, compare Texas flats with South Carolina flood tides, and plan a sight-fishing trip with source-linked checks.
- [Ontario fly-in fishing: outpost vs lodge, licence, packing](https://castward.app/trip-types/ontario-fly-in-fishing/): Fly-in fishing in Ontario means a floatplane to a lodge or outpost cabin for walleye and pike. Compare both, see visitor licence fees and pack to the weight limit.
- [Best time to fish the Florida Keys: choose by target](https://castward.app/guides/best-time-to-fish-florida-keys/): Choose a Florida Keys fishing season by target and trip type. Compare official seasonal references, weather checks and the rules for your planned water.
- [First offshore fishing charter: a practical checklist](https://castward.app/guides/first-offshore-fishing-charter-checklist/): Prepare for your first offshore charter. Check the boat, crew, time at sea, packing list, license coverage and weather terms before departure.
- [What to bring on a guided fishing trip](https://castward.app/guides/what-to-bring-on-a-guided-fishing-trip/): Pack for a guided fishing trip with a personal day-bag list, method-specific additions and a clear split between your gear and confirmed guide provisions.
- [Inshore vs offshore fishing charter: which fits you?](https://castward.app/guides/inshore-vs-offshore-fishing-charter/): Compare inshore and offshore charters by travel time, exposure, fishing method, comfort and gear. Choose the trip that fits your group and dates.
- [How to choose a fishing guide for your trip](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-choose-a-fishing-guide/): Choose a fishing guide by trip fit, verifiable permissions, instruction, written terms and equipment provision. Compare operators without catch guarantees.
- [Alaska Fishing Trip Packing List: Layers, Gear, and Rules](https://castward.app/guides/alaska-fishing-packing-list/): Pack for an Alaska fishing trip with a printable checklist, three-layer clothing chart, felt-soled wader ban, nonresident license fees, and TSA rod rules.
- [Florida Keys fishing packing list: flats or offshore](https://castward.app/guides/florida-keys-fishing-packing-list/): Pack for a Florida Keys fishing trip with separate flats and offshore choices, a personal day bag, confirmed crew provisions and official rule links.
- [First Montana fly-fishing trip: wade, float and pack](https://castward.app/guides/montana-first-fly-fishing-trip/): Plan a first Montana fly-fishing trip with wade and float choices, borrowed-gear questions, official access checks and current waterbody restrictions.
- [Questions to ask a fishing guide before you book](https://castward.app/guides/guided-fishing-trip-questions/): Use a copyable fishing-guide inquiry and a quote comparison checklist. Confirm the target, departure, gear, license coverage and cancellation terms.
- [Fishing gear you already own: check before you buy](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-gear-you-already-own/): Check existing fishing gear for fit, condition and compatibility. Separate owned items from confirmed guide provisions and buy only the missing requirements.
- [One-week fishing trip checklist: plan, pack and return](https://castward.app/guides/one-week-fishing-trip-checklist/): Prepare a week-long fishing trip with a timed checklist, clothing quantities, separate travel and day bags, guide questions and final rule checks.
- [A warmer start. A better base.](https://castward.app/guides/merino-wool-fishing-base-layers/): Compare merino fishing base layers by weight, fit, and care. See why two pure-wool tops can need different wash and drying methods.
- [Fishing waders: fit, types and winter boot checks](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-waders-buying-guide/): Choose fishing waders by body, inseam, and foot size. Use a worked size-chart example and winter fit checks before you buy.
- [Fishing layers: what to wear under waders](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-layering-system-guide/): What to wear under waders or in an ice fishing house: compare base, insulation, and shell layers, test the full fit, and pack dry spares.
- [Fishing gear tiers: what is worth the upgrade?](https://castward.app/guides/fishing-gear-quality-tiers/): Decide which fishing gear upgrade earns its place. Compare exact reel sizes, rental inclusions, fit, and the full setup before you spend.
- [Your first evening at the vise.](https://castward.app/guides/fly-tying-for-beginners/): Learn the tools, sort the materials, and tie a fly you can recognize. Start small. Keep the next one simple.
- [Five flies. A good place to start.](https://castward.app/guides/first-five-flies-to-tie/): From a simple worm to a buoyant caddis: five picture-led lessons that teach the skills you will use at the vise.
- [A better first bench.](https://castward.app/guides/fly-tying-kit-buying-guide/): Choose a kit that fits your table, your hands, and the flies you want to tie. Skip the box of materials you will never use.
- [How to tie a Woolly Bugger](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-woolly-bugger/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie a Pheasant Tail Nymph](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-pheasant-tail-nymph/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie an Elk Hair Caddis](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-an-elk-hair-caddis/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie a Zebra Midge](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-zebra-midge/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [How to tie a San Juan Worm](https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-san-juan-worm/): One fly, eight clear steps. Gather the materials, follow each stage, and check the finished shape before you start the next one.
- [Minnesota ice fishing packing list: rental houses](https://castward.app/guides/minnesota-ice-fishing-packing-list/): Pack for a Minnesota ice fishing rental house with a day or overnight checklist. Check bedding, tackle, cookware, power, and the return plan.
- [First tarpon fishing trip: a Florida starter guide](https://castward.app/guides/first-tarpon-fishing-trip/): Choose a Florida tarpon trip by region, season and method. Compare two realistic first-trip plans, pack a small bag and prepare for an in-water release.
- [Florida Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-florida/): Visitors aged 16 or older need freshwater or saltwater coverage for the species they target. The free shoreline licence is only for Florida residents.
- [Alaska Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-alaska/): Non-residents aged 16 or older need a sport fishing licence. A king salmon stamp is normally required even when you release the fish.
- [California Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-california/): Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species repor
- [Minnesota Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-minnesota/): Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Visiting children under 16 must use a parent's or guardian's licence or obtain a youth licence.
- [Montana Fishing License](https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/us-montana/): Anglers aged 12 or older need a base fishing licence, Conservation Licence, and AIS prevention pass. The advertised base price does not include both r

### A warmer start. A better base.
https://castward.app/guides/merino-wool-fishing-base-layers/
Updated 2026-11-14
Choose a lighter merino base for a long walk and compare heavier fabric for cold, quiet sessions. Smartwool is my pick for the best 100% merino wool brand: its Classic Thermal crew uses 250 g/m² fabric and flatlock seams. Add insulation and a shell for the conditions; fabric weight is not a temperature rating.

### Fishing waders: fit, types and winter boot checks
https://castward.app/guides/fishing-waders-buying-guide/
Updated 2026-11-14
Start with the maker’s measurements and try the waders with your actual layers. Check chest, inseam, and foot size separately. For winter, test the stockingfoot inside the boot with your chosen socks. More fabric is useful only when the complete outfit still lets you move comfortably.

### Fishing layers: what to wear under waders
https://castward.app/guides/fishing-layering-system-guide/
Updated 2026-11-15
Use a base layer for moisture, an insulating layer for warmth, and a shell for wind and rain. Adjust the combination when you switch from walking to standing. Under waders, check the whole outfit for crowded seams and restricted movement. Pack a dry base layer and socks for the return.

### Fishing gear tiers: what is worth the upgrade?
https://castward.app/guides/fishing-gear-quality-tiers/
Updated 2026-11-14
Choose fishing gear by the job it must do, not its price tier. Confirm the guide’s supplied tackle, then fill the gaps in fit, weather protection, and line setup. My inshore reel pick is Daiwa BG for its aluminum housing and screw-in handle; choose the exact size for your rod and line.

### Your first evening at the vise.
https://castward.app/guides/fly-tying-for-beginners/
Updated 2026-11-11
Start with a San Juan Worm, then try a Woolly Bugger. Buy the materials for one pattern, set up good light, and work toward an open hook eye and secure wraps.

### Five flies. A good place to start.
https://castward.app/guides/first-five-flies-to-tie/
Updated 2026-11-11
Start with the San Juan Worm for thread control. Move to the Woolly Bugger, then the Zebra Midge, Pheasant Tail, and Elk Hair Caddis. Each lesson has eight illustrated stages.

### A better first bench.
https://castward.app/guides/fly-tying-kit-buying-guide/
Updated 2026-11-11
Wapsi Starter Kit is my pick for a complete first kit. It includes tools, materials, and a handbook for ten trout patterns. Choose it if those patterns match the flies you want to tie.

### How to tie a Woolly Bugger
https://castward.app/guides/how-to-tie-a-woolly-bugger/
Updated 2026-11-11
Take one stage at a time. Keep the hook eye clear, use only the material the step needs, and check each tie-in before you move on.

### Florida visitor fishing license planner
https://castward.app/guides/florida-visitor-fishing-license-planner/
Updated 2026-11-12
Start with the trip, not the cheapest license. A visitor cannot use Florida’s free resident shoreline license. Confirm charter or pier coverage with the operator; buy personal coverage for separate shore or private-boat outings. Freshwater trips need their own check. Species permits and catch rules can still apply.

### Minnesota fish house rental: compare two trips
https://castward.app/guides/minnesota-fish-house-rental-checklist/
Updated 2026-11-15
Choose the amount of help you need before you compare the price. Ask who teaches the fishing setup, who takes you to the house, and how you return early. Then separate supplied gear from your own packing list. Get the changed-conditions policy in writing before you pay.

### Minnesota ice fishing packing list: rental houses
https://castward.app/guides/minnesota-ice-fishing-packing-list/
Updated 2026-11-15
For a Minnesota rental fish house, pack outdoor layers, waterproof winter boots, dry spares, food, water, and the license your trip requires. Add bedding and cookware for an overnight stay unless the operator supplies them. Confirm rods, bait, transport, and power separately; a heated house does not include every item.

### First tarpon fishing trip: a Florida starter guide
https://castward.app/guides/first-tarpon-fishing-trip/
Updated 2026-11-15
For your first Florida tarpon trip, choose the region and fishing method before you choose a date. Ask the captain to match the tackle and boat to your experience. Plan for catch and release, keep large fish in the water, and agree on a weather alternative before you book.

### Ice fishing
https://castward.app/environments/ice-fishing/
Updated 2026-11-14
For a first ice-fishing trip, choose an experienced companion, a guided session, or a rental with clearly stated support. Check current access and the full route before stepping onto ice. Bring dry layers, waterproof insulated boots, and accessible rescue equipment. Confirm the licence, lake rules, tackle, and return transport before you leave.

### Fraser River catch and release sturgeon fishing
https://castward.app/trip-types/fraser-white-sturgeon/
Updated 2026-11-21
Fraser River sturgeon fishing is catch and release only. In non-tidal waters, you need a B.C. freshwater licence and White Sturgeon Conservation Licence; tidal trips need the DFO licence. Use a single barbless hook, keep large fish in the water, and check closures for your exact reach before you fish.

### Buoy 10 salmon fishing: season and charter checklist
https://castward.app/trip-types/buoy-10-salmon/
Updated 2026-11-17
Buoy 10 salmon fishing starts with the rule for your date. For November 1–December 31, 2026, ODFW allows two adult hatchery coho or hatchery steelhead combined from Buoy 10 to Bonneville Dam; release all Chinook. Check the latest notice, barbless hooks, launch and weather plan before you book.

### Sight fishing: what tailing redfish mean
https://castward.app/trip-types/sight-fishing/
Updated 2026-11-17
Sight fishing means finding the fish before you cast. A tailing redfish feeds head-down in shallow water, with its tail above the surface. Look for that feeding posture, then plan your approach. The useful tide depends on the flat: a South Carolina flood-tide rule does not transfer to a Texas bay.

### Fly-in fishing in Ontario: outpost or lodge, licence and packing
https://castward.app/trip-types/ontario-fly-in-fishing/
Updated 2026-11-22
Fly-in fishing in Ontario means a floatplane takes you to a lake with no road. You stay at a full-service lodge or a self-catered outpost cabin and fish from small boats, mostly for walleye and northern pike. Most adult visitors need an Ontario fishing licence. Pack to your air operator’s weight limit.

## Fish identification and first trips

### Tarakihi (Nemadactylus macropterus): names and ID
https://castward.app/species/tarakihi/
Updated 2026-11-17
Tarakihi is Nemadactylus macropterus, or jackass morwong. Check its dark shoulder band, long pectoral-fin ray, local names and fishing destinations.

### Common dace (Leuciscus leuciscus): names and ID
https://castward.app/species/common-dace/
Updated 2026-11-17
Identify common dace, Leuciscus leuciscus, by its slender silver body, forked tail and small mouth. Check river habitat, local names and destinations.

### Largemouth bass fishing, local names and destinations
https://castward.app/species/largemouth-bass/
Updated 2026-11-25
Find largemouth bass from a pier or bank near weeds, lily pads and fallen wood. Use the beginner habitat table, bait advice and official rules.

### Cachama fish (Colossoma macropomum): tambaqui
https://castward.app/species/cachama/
Updated 2026-11-18
Cachama is Colossoma macropomum, also called tambaqui, black pacu or gamitana. Check its native river basins, regional names and linked destinations.

### European flounder (Platichthys flesus): ID and habitat
https://castward.app/species/european-flounder/
Updated 2026-11-18
Identify European flounder by its rough fin edges and mottled upper side. See its coastal, estuary and freshwater habitats with Irish fisheries sources.

### Pacific herring habitat: where Clupea pallasii lives
https://castward.app/species/pacific-herring/
Updated 2026-11-18
Where are Pacific herring found? Compare coastal waters, sheltered bays and spawning habitat, from Baja California to Alaska, with NOAA and DFO sources.

### Shoal bass (Micropterus cataractae): habitat and size
https://castward.app/species/shoal-bass/
Updated 2026-11-19
Identify shoal bass, compare adult size, and find their native river basin. Read the habitat facts before choosing a Georgia or Florida fishing trip.

### Mozambique tilapia: Oreochromis mossambicus facts
https://castward.app/species/mozambique-tilapia/
Updated 2026-11-19
Identify Mozambique tilapia, its African native range and reported size. Compare freshwater and brackish habitat with sources from FishBase and USFWS.

### Coarse fishing: fish species, methods and seasons
https://castward.app/species/coarse-fish/
Updated 2026-11-19
What is coarse fishing? Learn which fish the name covers, compare float and feeder methods, and check river seasons before your trip.

### Milkfish (Chanos chanos): habitat, size and identification
https://castward.app/species/milkfish/
Updated 2026-11-19
Identify milkfish, Chanos chanos, by the toothless mouth and deeply forked tail. Compare adult coastal habitat with juvenile mangrove and lagoon habitat.

### Yakutat fishing: Situk River, halibut and trip planning
https://castward.app/destinations/yakutat/
Updated 2026-11-19
Plan a Yakutat fishing trip around Situk River salmon, steelhead or coastal halibut. Compare access, seasonal patterns and the gear questions to ask.

### Nepal fishing licence: permits, prices and where to ask
https://castward.app/fishing-licenses/np/
Updated 2026-11-20
Nepal fishing permission depends on the water. Ask the park or conservation office; a national visitor price is not stated. See official permit sources.
